cohort: 200 pregnant women who had completed 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Antenatal manual breast milk expression at term shortens the time taken to establish full lactation and improves postnatal lactational performance
mod_finding: Full lactation within 6 hours of delivery was achieved by 100% of women who had a vaginal delivery and had performed antenatal breast milk expression, compared with 81% of those who had not; 80% of women who had a lower segment caesarean section and had performed antenatal breast milk expression established full lactation within 6 hours, compared with 61% of those who had not.
